services.name: Summer Camps
services.desc: Tuition is due at the time of registration unless on an installment plan. Payment installments are made in thirds. You will be charged at checkout, on April 1st 2025 (4/1/25), and on June 1st 2025 (6/1/25). Payment plans will automatically resolve. Cancellations and refund requests, submitted at least four (4) weeks prior to the start of the camp in which you are registered, will receive a full refund, minus a $30 administration fee. Transfer requests are dependent on camp availability and may be subject to additional fees depending on the cost of the camp into which your child is transferring. Funds can also be credited to your Active Network account to use towards a future registration at

blurb: A sparkling supernatural comedy that follows novelist Charles Condomine as he invites an eccentric medium to his home for research-only to accidentally summon the ghost of his mischievous first wife, Elvira.
